units.source_text: “啊……那儿只有两种下法，要么扳要么长，大约很多人都会猜着吧。”名人说。

en.t: "Ah... there are only two moves there, either to hane or to extend, so I suppose many people would guess it," the Master said.

units.source_text: 他的背影自然挺直，抬起头正襟危坐。

en.t: His back was naturally straight, and he lifted his head and sat upright with formal composure.

units.source_text: 这是对局的姿势，威风凛凛。

en.t: It was the posture of a match, imposing and dignified.

units.source_text: 面对虚空的棋盘，名人久久地露出忘我的神态。

en.t: Facing the empty board before him, the Master wore an absorbed, self-forgetful expression for a long time.
